mapper.select: SELECT i.inquiry_id, i.branch_code, b.name AS branch_name, i.title, i.content, i.category, i.urgency, i.status, DATE_FORMAT(i.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS created_at_formatted, DATE_FORMAT(i.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updated_at_formatted, r.reply_id, r.author_id, e.name AS author_name, r.content AS reply_content, rb.name as reply_author_affiliation, DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS reply_created_at_formatted FROM inquiry i JOIN branch b ON i.branch_code = b.branch_code LEFT JOIN inquiry_reply r ON i.inquiry_id = r.inquiry_id LEFT JOIN account a ON r.author_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN employee e ON a.emp_no = e.emp_no LEFT JOIN branch rb ON a.branch_code = rb.branch_code WHERE i.inquiry_id = #{inquiryId} ORDER BY r.created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inquiry (branch_code, title, content, category, urgency, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{branchCode}, #{title}, #{content}, #{category}, #{urgency}, '대기 중', #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
INSERT INTO inquiry_reply (inquiry_id, author_id, content, created_at) VALUES (#{inquiryId}, #{authorId}, #{content}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE inquiry SET status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE inquiry_id = #{inquiryId}
